AIHigherEdHub.about: Searchable hub of articles and resources on AI in higher education, filterable by category and keyword.

AIPMHub.about: News hub on how AI is transforming project management: planning, risk, agile delivery, portfolio and tools. Refreshed every six hours.

AlbanianRevolution.about: Live global news tracker following Albania's Flamingo Revolution protests, with a running protest-day counter; articles refresh every six hours.

ChangeManagement.about: Change management builder: describe an organizational change and get a generated change package, dashboard and follow-up guidance.

DATP.about: Project Management Solution Builder: AI tool that turns plain-language process descriptions into editable workflow flowcharts.

FlowChart.about: AI workflow builder that turns plain-language descriptions, documents or images into editable flowcharts, with version history and saving.

GanttChartBuilder.about: Build project timelines as Gantt charts with task dependencies, from templates or your own tasks; export as PNG.

ImageToPDF.about: One-page tool that converts a JPG or PNG image into a downloadable A4 PDF in seconds.

LinkSnap.about: Instant peer-to-peer video calls and screen sharing in the browser through a shareable link; no accounts needed.

NewsHub.about: Earlier version of the AI in Higher Ed hub: searchable, category-filtered news about AI in universities.

QuickSnap.about: Tiny macOS menu-bar screenshot tool: press ⌘⇧2, drag a box, mark it up, and it's copied to your clipboard.

ShortLink.about: Simple URL shortener: paste a long link and get a short shareable one. Free, no sign-up.

Smart-Backpack-Organizer.about: Mobile-friendly app that tells parents exactly what their child needs to pack for school each day.

TeachingwithAI.about: Chapter-by-chapter notes on teaching with AI: AI literacy, classroom use, academic integrity, grading and feedback, with saveable notes.

apartment-3d.about: Interactive furnished 3D model of a 120 m² fourth-floor apartment with balcony, day/evening lighting and room labels.

git-dashboard.about: This dashboard: daily, weekly, monthly and yearly views and clones for all your GitHub repositories, collected every day.

period-mirror.about: Privacy-first menstrual health companion that learns your personal baseline and highlights meaningful changes; mobile-first and non-diagnostic.

spot-flow-desk.about: Hourly-updated dashboard of US spot Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana and XRP ETF inflows and outflows by day, week, month and year.
